Hi Julie —

Attaching a first-draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a sizing worksheet that aligns our Dedicated/Private lead times with your launch milestones. High level:

- Two reservation pathways: Tranche A (steady commit) and Tranche B (staggered ramp) with corresponding GPU pool sizing options.
- Lead time estimates: Dedicated (provisioned in-region): 6–8 weeks after PO; Private/on-prem: 8–12 weeks depending on customer infra readiness and KMS integration.
- Acceptance cadence: QA smoke tests (3 days), performance validation (5 days), production canary (2 weeks).

Key asks from Altura to finalize timeline:
1) Confirm target QPS/avg seq length for eval workloads (sample traffic).
2) Indicate preferred reservation pathway (Tranche A vs B).
3) Procurement window + PO target date so we can lock capacity procurement lanes.

I attached MAP-Altura-v1.pdf and GPU-Sizing-worksheet-v2.xlsx. Suggested next step: 30-min call this week to walk the worksheet and lock the commit date. Available Wed/Thu morning PST.

Julie — thanks, and glad InfoSec is satisfied. Shortening the perf validation window to 3 days is feasible if we agree on a constrained KPI checklist. Proposed guardrails:

- Required passes for 3-day validation:
  * Latency: P95 <= 300ms for baseline demo traffic (at canary traffic levels).
  * Throughput: sustained QPS at 85% of target for 2 of 3 validation days.
  * Quality smoke: 25 curated prompts (from Altura) must meet previously agreed quality thresholds (precision/recall heuristics).

- If the 3-day run shows regressions in quality or latency, we revert to the 5-day extended validation (no charge for additional test window).
- Timeline impact: with PO 2025-07-15 and Dedicated option selected, provisioning + 3-day validation + 2-week canary suggests a production handover target of 2025-09-08. We’ll add a one-week contingency buffer to account for delivery variability.

If that looks good, Mateo will publish an updated MAP and send the DocuSign link for signatures.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Director, Solution Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
